+function parseStdoutRunBlocks(content, byNum, { legacyOffset = false } = {}) {
+  const stdoutRe = /^\s*<!--\s*stdout from (codex\s+)?run (\d+)\s+(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})[^>]*-->([\s\S]*?)(?=^\s*<!--\s*stdout from (?:codex\s+)?run \d|^\s*## Run \d|$(?![\s\S]))/gm
+  let m
+  while ((m = stdoutRe.exec(content)) !== null) {
+    const [, codexMarker, slotStr, date, body] = m
+    const failed = body.includes('[run failed')
+    const boldRun = body.match(/\*\*Run (\d+)\s*(?:[—-]\s*([\w ]+?)\s*[—-]|\s*[—-]\s*done)/)
+    const num = boldRun ? parseInt(boldRun[1]) : parseInt(slotStr) + (!codexMarker && legacyOffset ? 1 : 0)
+    if (!num) continue
+
+    const rawType = boldRun?.[2]?.trim().toUpperCase() || ''
+    const type = failed ? 'FAILED' : ['MUTATE','RESEARCH','CREATE','RUN'].find(t => rawType.includes(t)) || rawType || 'RUN'
+    const lines = body.split('\n').map(l => l.trim()).filter(Boolean)
+    const failureLine = lines.find(l => l.startsWith('[run failed'))
+    const detailLine = lines.find(l =>
+      !l.startsWith('[run failed') &&
+      !l.startsWith('**Run') &&
+      !l.startsWith('---') &&
+      !l.startsWith('```')
+    )
+    const summary = failed
+      ? [failureLine, detailLine].filter(Boolean).join(' ')
+      : detailLine || ''
+
+    const existing = byNum.get(num)
+    const placeholder = existing?.type === 'RUN' && existing?.['What I changed'] === 'stdout captured with no summary'
+    if (!existing || (failed && placeholder)) {
+      byNum.set(num, { num, date, type, 'What I changed': summary || 'stdout captured with no summary' })
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+function parseFormalRunBlocks(content) {
+  const byNum = new Map()
+  const sections = content.split(/(?=^## Run \d)/m).filter(s => s.trimStart().startsWith('## Run'))
+  for (const block of sections) {
+    const lines = block.split('\n')
+    const header = lines[0].replace('## Run ', '').trim()
+    const parts = header.split(/\s+[—-]\s+/).map(s => s.trim())
+    const [num, date, type] = parts
+    const fields = {}
+    for (const line of lines.slice(1)) {
+      if (line.startsWith('<!--')) break
+      const m = line.match(/^\*\*(.+?):\*\*\s*(.+)/)
+      if (m) fields[m[1]] = m[2]
+    }
+    const n = parseInt(num) || 0
+    if (n) byNum.set(n, { num: n, date, type, ...fields })
+  }
+  return byNum
+}
+
+function parseRunsFromLog(content, options = {}) {
+  const byNum = parseFormalRunBlocks(content)
+  parseStdoutRunBlocks(content, byNum, options)
+  return [...byNum.values()].sort((a, b) => a.num - b.num)
+}

+// ─── AI analysis strip ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+const AI_FIELD_META = [
+  { key: 'DIRECTION', label: 'Direction', color: 'var(--accent)' },
+  { key: 'STRONGEST', label: 'Strongest', color: '#22c55e' },
+  { key: 'WEAKEST',   label: 'Weakest',   color: '#f97316' },
+  { key: 'DRIFT',     label: 'Drift',     color: '#a78bfa' },
+  { key: 'NEXT',      label: 'Next',      color: '#38bdf8' },
+]
+
+function parseAnalysis(text) {
+  const fields = {}
+  const re = /([A-Z]{2,}[A-Z\s]*):\s*\n?([\s\S]*?)(?=\n[A-Z]{2,}[A-Z\s]*:|$)/g
+  let m
+  while ((m = re.exec(text.replace(/\*\*/g, '').replace(/\r/g, ''))) !== null) {
+    const key = m[1].trim().toUpperCase()
+    const val = m[2].trim().replace(/\n+/g, ' ')
+    if (val && AI_FIELD_META.some(f => f.key === key)) fields[key] = val
+  }
+  return fields
+}
+
+function AiStrip({ slotId, autoTrigger }) {
+  const [open, setOpen]         = useState(false)
+  const [analysis, setAnalysis] = useState(null)
+  const [loading, setLoading]   = useState(false)
+  const [error, setError]       = useState(null)
+  const [lastRun, setLastRun]   = useState(null)
+  const prevTriggerBySlotRef    = useRef({})
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    setAnalysis(null)
+    setError(null)
+    setLastRun(null)
+    if (!slotId) return
+    fetch(`/api/incubators/${slotId}/ai/latest`)
+      .then(async r => {
+        const text = await r.text()
+        try { return JSON.parse(text) }
+        catch { throw new Error('AI feedback API returned HTML, not JSON') }
+      })
+      .then(d => {
+        if (d.ok && d.response) {
+          setAnalysis(parseAnalysis(d.response))
+          setLastRun(new Date(d.ts).toLocaleTimeString())
+        }
+      })
+      .catch(err => setError(err.message))
+  }, [slotId])
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    if (!slotId) return
+    const prev = prevTriggerBySlotRef.current[slotId]
+    if (prev == null) {
+      prevTriggerBySlotRef.current[slotId] = autoTrigger
+      return
+    }
+    if (autoTrigger > prev && !loading) {
+      prevTriggerBySlotRef.current[slotId] = autoTrigger
+      runAnalysis()
+    } else if (autoTrigger > prev) {
+      prevTriggerBySlotRef.current[slotId] = autoTrigger
+    }
+  }, [slotId, autoTrigger])
+
+  async function runAnalysis(e) {
+    e?.stopPropagation()
+    setLoading(true)
+    setError(null)
+    setOpen(true)
+    try {
+      const r = await fetch(`/api/incubators/${slotId}/ai/analyze`, { method: 'POST' })
+      const text = await r.text()
+      let d
+      try { d = JSON.parse(text) }
+      catch { throw new Error('AI feedback API returned HTML, not JSON') }
+      if (!d.ok) throw new Error(d.error || 'failed')
+      setAnalysis(parseAnalysis(d.response))
+      setLastRun(new Date().toLocaleTimeString())
+    } catch (err) {
+      setError(err.message)
+    } finally {
+      setLoading(false)
+    }
+  }
+
+  const active = loading || !!analysis

+function generateDemoStats(prev) {
+  const now = Date.now()
+  const cpu = Math.max(2, Math.min(95,
+    (prev?.cpu ?? 25) + (Math.random() - 0.45) * 12
+  ))
+  const memPercent = Math.max(20, Math.min(90,

+export function useRuns(pollInterval = 30_000) {
+  const [runs, setRuns] = useState([])
+  const loadRef = useRef(null)
+
+  useEffect(() => {
+    const load = () =>
+      fetch('/api/runs')
+        .then(r => r.json())
+        .then(setRuns)
+        .catch(() => {})
+
+    loadRef.current = load
+    load()
+
+    // SSE for instant updates when a run completes — EventSource auto-reconnects
+    const es = new EventSource('/api/runs/stream')
+    es.onmessage = () => load()
+
+    // Polling as safety net in case SSE drops silently
+    const id = setInterval(load, pollInterval)
+
+    return () => {
+      es.close()
+      clearInterval(id)
+    }
+  }, [pollInterval])
+
+  const refresh = useCallback(() => { loadRef.current?.() }, [])
+
+  return [runs, refresh]
+}

+## Run 89 — 2026-07-03 — MUTATE
+
+**What I changed:** Made selected-incubator AI feedback load from saved per-incubator state, added Core incubator feedback support, and forced unknown `/api/*` routes to return JSON 404s.
+**Why:** The seed called out stale/global AI feedback, misleading AI HAT+ labeling, card-switch-triggered regeneration, and API fallthroughs that produce `Unexpected token '<'`.
+**What improved:** Core now exposes its saved local Ollama/Qwen feedback through the same incubator strip as projects, switching cards no longer consumes an old trigger as a fresh analysis request, and bad API paths no longer fall through to `index.html`.
+**What broke:** Auto-analysis still keys off parsed run-list length, so repeated stdout blocks with the same parsed run number may not retrigger feedback.
+**Next move:** Track a stable per-incubator latest-run signature instead of list length so failed repeated runs and same-number stdout blocks can trigger one fresh local analysis.
+

+## Run 90 — 2026-07-03 — MUTATE
+
+**What I changed:** Preserved repeated stdout-only failed runs as distinct history records and keyed local AI feedback refreshes from the latest run signature instead of run-list length.
+**Why:** The seed called out failed stdout-only runs disappearing or showing empty summaries, and the active thread identified same-number failures collapsing before the incubator could explain them.
+**What improved:** The Core history now surfaces each repeated `codex exited 127` attempt as `FAILED` with the actual command error, and fixed-size histories can still trigger fresh per-incubator Qwen feedback when the latest run changes.
+**What broke:** The UI still displays repeated attempts with the same run number rather than a visible attempt suffix, so the distinct failures are separable by order and message but not yet labeled as attempt 1/2/3.
+**Next move:** Add runner/path preflight validation before enabling Codex scheduled runs so `codex: command not found` is caught before the loop spends a run.

++**What I changed:** Preserved repeated stdout-only failed runs as distinct history records and keyed local AI feedback refreshes from the latest run signature instead of run-list length.
++**Why:** The seed called out failed stdout-only runs disappearing or showing empty summaries, and the active thread identified same-number failures collapsing before the incubator could explain them.
++**What improved:** The Core history now surfaces each repeated `codex exited 127` attempt as `FAILED` with the actual command error, and fixed-size histories can still trigger fresh per-incubator Qwen feedback when the latest run changes.
++**What broke:** The UI still displays repeated attempts with the same run number rather than a visible attempt suffix, so the distinct failures are separable by order and message but not yet labeled as attempt 1/2/3.
++**Next move:** Add runner/path preflight validation before enabling Codex scheduled runs so `codex: command not found` is caught before the loop spends a run.

+  res.setHeader('Content-Type', 'text/event-stream')
+  res.setHeader('Cache-Control', 'no-cache')
+  res.setHeader('Connection', 'keep-alive')
+  res.flushHeaders()
+  runClients.add(res)

+    try { res.write(':heartbeat\n\n') } catch { clearInterval(heartbeat) }
+  }, 25000)

+    runClients.delete(res)
+    clearInterval(heartbeat)
+  })

+    const boldRun = body.match(/\*\*Run (\d+)\s*(?:[—-]\s*([\w ]+?)\s*[—-]|\s*[—-]\s*done)/)
+    const num = boldRun ? parseInt(boldRun[1]) : parseInt(slotStr) + (!codexMarker && legacyOffset ? 1 : 0)
+    if (!num) continue
+
+    const rawType = boldRun?.[2]?.trim().toUpperCase() || ''
+    const type = failed ? 'FAILED' : ['MUTATE','RESEARCH','CREATE','RUN'].find(t => rawType.includes(t)) || rawType || 'RUN'
+    const lines = body.split('\n').map(l => l.trim()).filter(Boolean)
+    const failureLine = lines.find(l => l.startsWith('[run failed'))
+    const detailLine = lines.find(l =>
+      !l.startsWith('[run failed') &&
+      !l.startsWith('**Run') &&
+      !l.startsWith('---') &&
+      !l.startsWith('```')
+    )
+    const summary = failed
+      ? [failureLine, detailLine].filter(Boolean).join(' ')
+      : detailLine || ''
+
+    const formal = runs.find(r => r.num === num && r._source === 'formal')
+    if (formal && !failed) continue
+
+    const run = {
+      num,
+      date,
+      type,
+      'What I changed': summary || 'stdout captured with no summary',
+      _order: m.index,
+      _source: 'stdout',
+    }
+    run.signature = runSignature(run)
+    runs.push(run)
+  }
+}
+
+function parseFormalRunBlocks(content) {
+  const runs = []
+  const sections = content.split(/(?=^## Run \d)/m).filter(s => s.trimStart().startsWith('## Run'))
+  let searchFrom = 0
+  for (const block of sections) {
+    const order = content.indexOf(block, searchFrom)
+    if (order >= 0) searchFrom = order + block.length
+    const lines = block.split('\n')
+    const header = lines[0].replace('## Run ', '').trim()
+    const parts = header.split(/\s+[—-]\s+/).map(s => s.trim())
+    const [num, date, type] = parts
+    const fields = {}
+    for (const line of lines.slice(1)) {
+      if (line.startsWith('<!--')) break
+      const m = line.match(/^\*\*(.+?):\*\*\s*(.+)/)
+      if (m) fields[m[1]] = m[2]
+    }
+    const n = parseInt(num) || 0
+    if (n) {
+      const run = { num: n, date, type, ...fields, _order: order >= 0 ? order : runs.length, _source: 'formal' }
+      run.signature = runSignature(run)
+      runs.push(run)
+    }
+  }
+  return runs
+}

+function parseRunsFromLog(content, options = {}) {
+  const runs = parseFormalRunBlocks(content)
+  parseStdoutRunBlocks(content, runs, options)
+  return runs
+    .sort((a, b) => (a._order ?? 0) - (b._order ?? 0))
+    .map(publicRun)

+import { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react'

+
+const KEY_MAP = {
+  DIRECTION: ['direction', 'dir', 'duration', 'heading'],
+  STRONGEST: ['strongest', 'strong', 'best', 'winning'],
+  WEAKEST:   ['weakest', 'weak', 'worst', 'problem'],
+  DRIFT:     ['drift', 'drifting'],
+  NEXT:      ['next', 'mutate', 'suggested', 'suggestion', 'move', 'priority'],
+}
+
+function parseAnalysis(text) {
+  const fields = {}
+  const cleaned = text.replace(/\*\*/g, '').replace(/\r/g, '')
+  const re = /([A-Z]{2,}[A-Z\s]*):\s*\n?([\s\S]*?)(?=\n[A-Z]{2,}[A-Z\s]*:|$)/g
+  let m
+  while ((m = re.exec(cleaned)) !== null) {
+    const rawKey = m[1].trim().toLowerCase()
+    const value = m[2].trim().replace(/\n+/g, ' ')
+    if (!value) continue
+    for (const [canonical, aliases] of Object.entries(KEY_MAP)) {
+      if (aliases.some(a => rawKey.includes(a))) {
+        fields[canonical] = value
+        break
+      }
+    }
+  }
+  return fields
+}

+const LOG_TYPE_COLOR = { CREATE: '#22d3ee', MUTATE: '#a78bfa', RESEARCH: '#34d399', HARVEST: '#fbbf24' }
+const LOG_FIELD_COLOR = {
+  'What I changed': '#e2e8f0', 'What I built': '#e2e8f0', 'What I investigated': '#e2e8f0',

+}
+
+function parseRunLog(content) {
+  const blocks = content.split(/(?=^## Run \d)/m).filter(s => s.trimStart().startsWith('## Run'))
+  return blocks.map(block => {
+    // Strip stdout comment dumps
+    const clean = block.replace(/<!--[\s\S]*?-->/g, '').replace(/\n{3,}/g, '\n\n').trim()
+    const lines = clean.split('\n')
+    const header = lines[0].replace('## Run ', '')
+    const parts = header.split(' — ').map(s => s.trim())
+    const num = parts[0], date = parts[1], type = parts[2]
+    const fields = []
+    for (const line of lines.slice(1)) {
+      const m = line.match(/^\*\*(.+?):\*\*\s*(.+)/)
+      if (m) fields.push({ label: m[1], value: m[2] })
+    }
+    return { num, date, type, fields }
+  }).reverse()
+}

+// ─── Helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+function fmtElapsed(secs) {
+  if (!secs || secs < 1) return ''
+  const m = Math.floor(secs / 60)
+  const s = secs % 60
+  return m > 0 ? `${m}m ${s}s` : `${s}s`
+}
+
+function fmtAgo(ts) {
+  const mins = Math.floor((Date.now() - ts) / 60000)
+  if (mins < 1) return 'just now'
+  if (mins === 1) return '1 min ago'
+  if (mins < 60) return `${mins} min ago`
+  return `${Math.floor(mins / 60)}h ago`
+}

+## Run 92 — 2026-07-03 — RESEARCH
+
+**What I investigated:** Pi Pulse incubator-host reliability around run parsing, API JSON boundaries, per-incubator local Ollama/Qwen feedback, and runner preflight behavior.
+**Key finding:** `parseStdoutRunBlocks()` treats any stdout body containing `[run failed` as failed; live `/api/runs` therefore reports a successful Codex stdout block for run 89 as `FAILED` because the transcript/log text contains that marker elsewhere.
+**Implication:** The next build run should tighten failure classification before adding more history UI, otherwise the timeline can confidently display false failures.
+**Suggested next move:** Change stdout failure detection to anchor on the first meaningful stdout line, then verify `/api/runs` no longer reports `FAILED #89` for `[run completed successfully...]` while still preserving real `codex exited 127` failures.

--- a/BACKLOG.md

 # Backlog
 
+## Run parser should anchor stdout failure detection
+`parseStdoutRunBlocks()` currently uses `body.includes('[run failed')`, which means a successful Codex transcript can become `FAILED` if it quotes earlier log text or a diff containing that marker. Live evidence on 2026-07-03: `/api/runs` reported `FAILED #89` with the summary `[run completed successfully; verbose Codex transcript omitted...]`. Change detection to inspect the first meaningful stdout line, e.g. `lines[0]?.startsWith('[run failed')`, and keep quoted historical failures out of the status classifier.
+
 ## ghost/whisper/oracle as incubated project
 The quartet (src/ghost/) is dormant — 5 standalone JS files, ports 3032–3036. Per the seed, it must NOT be integrated into Pi Pulse's Pulse tab UI. The correct pattern: create `projects/ghost-trio/status.json` with repo/runLog/runScript fields, point `mounted.json` at it, restart pi-pulse. Then the quartet gets its own ProjectPanel slot and run history without touching the waveform layer. One status.json + one run script = fully mounted. This is the right way to continue the ghost/oracle work without violating the "no new instruments" rule.

## Run 93 — 2026-07-03 — MUTATE

**What I changed:** Tightened stdout-only run parsing so `FAILED` is assigned only when the first meaningful runner line starts with `[run failed]`, while real failures still include the command error detail.
**Why:** The seed called for failed stdout-only runs to be visible with real errors, but the existing parser could also create false failures when successful transcripts merely quoted `[run failed]`.
**What improved:** `/api/runs` no longer reports the run 89 successful stdout transcript as `FAILED`, and a real `[run failed: codex exited 127]` block still surfaces `bash: codex: command not found`.
**What broke:** Full failure transcripts are still summarized to one detail line, so long command errors need a better drill-down surface.
**Next move:** Add an expandable failure detail view in the Core incubator history that shows the preserved stdout error context without overwhelming the compact timeline.

app.get('/api/stats', (req, res) => {
  res.json(buildStatsPayload())
})

function summarizeRun(run) {
  return run['Failure'] || run['Error'] || run['Goal'] || run['Done'] ||
    run['What I investigated'] || run['Investigated'] || run['What I built'] ||
    run['What I changed'] || run['What improved'] || run['What I found'] ||
    run['Key finding'] || run['Suggested next move'] || ''
}

function publicRun(run) {
  const { _order, _source, _attemptKey, ...rest } = run
  return rest
}

function runSignature(run) {
  return [
    run._source ?? 'run',
    run._order ?? 0,
    run.num ?? '',
    run.date ?? '',
    run.type ?? '',
    summarizeRun(run),
  ].join('|')
}

function parseStdoutRunBlocks(content, runs, { legacyOffset = false } = {}) {
  const stdoutRe = /^\s*<!--\s*stdout from (codex\s+)?run (\d+)\s+(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})[^>]*-->([\s\S]*?)(?=^\s*<!--\s*stdout from (?:codex\s+)?run \d|^\s*## Run \d|$(?![\s\S]))/gm
  let m
  while ((m = stdoutRe.exec(content)) !== null) {
    const [, codexMarker, slotStr, date, body] = m
    const failed = body.includes('[run failed')
    const boldRun = body.match(/\*\*Run (\d+)\s*(?:[—-]\s*([\w ]+?)\s*[—-]|\s*[—-]\s*done)/)
    const num = boldRun ? parseInt(boldRun[1]) : parseInt(slotStr) + (!codexMarker && legacyOffset ? 1 : 0)
    if (!num) continue

    const rawType = boldRun?.[2]?.trim().toUpperCase() || ''
    const type = failed ? 'FAILED' : ['MUTATE','RESEARCH','CREATE','RUN'].find(t => rawType.includes(t)) || rawType || 'RUN'
    const lines = body.split('\n').map(l => l.trim()).filter(Boolean)
    const failureLine = lines.find(l => l.startsWith('[run failed'))
    const detailLine = lines.find(l =>
      !l.startsWith('[run failed') &&
      !l.startsWith('**Run') &&
      !l.startsWith('---') &&
      !l.startsWith('```')
    )
    const summary = failed
      ? [failureLine, detailLine].filter(Boolean).join(' ')
      : detailLine || ''

    const formal = runs.find(r => r.num === num && r._source === 'formal')
    if (formal && !failed) continue

    const run = {
      num,
      date,
      type,
      'What I changed': summary || 'stdout captured with no summary',
      _order: m.index,
      _source: 'stdout',
    }
    run.signature = runSignature(run)
    runs.push(run)
  }
}

function parseFormalRunBlocks(content) {
  const runs = []
  const sections = content.split(/(?=^## Run \d)/m).filter(s => s.trimStart().startsWith('## Run'))
  let searchFrom = 0
  for (const block of sections) {
    const order = content.indexOf(block, searchFrom)
    if (order >= 0) searchFrom = order + block.length
    const lines = block.split('\n')
    const header = lines[0].replace('## Run ', '').trim()
    const parts = header.split(/\s+[—-]\s+/).map(s => s.trim())
    const [num, date, type] = parts
    const fields = {}
    for (const line of lines.slice(1)) {
      if (line.startsWith('<!--')) break
      const m = line.match(/^\*\*(.+?):\*\*\s*(.+)/)
      if (m) fields[m[1]] = m[2]
    }
    const n = parseInt(num) || 0
    if (n) {
      const run = { num: n, date, type, ...fields, _order: order >= 0 ? order : runs.length, _source: 'formal' }
      run.signature = runSignature(run)
      runs.push(run)
    }
  }
  return runs
}

function annotateRunAttempts(runs) {
  const totals = new Map()
  for (const run of runs) {
    const key = `${run.num ?? ''}|${run.date ?? ''}`
    totals.set(key, (totals.get(key) ?? 0) + 1)
  }

  const seen = new Map()
  return runs.map(run => {
    const key = `${run.num ?? ''}|${run.date ?? ''}`
    const attemptTotal = totals.get(key) ?? 1
    if (attemptTotal <= 1) return run

    const attempt = (seen.get(key) ?? 0) + 1
    seen.set(key, attempt)
    run._attemptKey = key
    run.attempt = attempt
    run.attemptTotal = attemptTotal
    run.signature = `${run.signature}|attempt:${attempt}/${attemptTotal}`
    return run
  })
}

function parseRunsFromLog(content, options = {}) {
  const runs = parseFormalRunBlocks(content)
  parseStdoutRunBlocks(content, runs, options)
  const sortedRuns = runs.sort((a, b) => (a._order ?? 0) - (b._order ?? 0))
  return annotateRunAttempts(sortedRuns).map(publicRun)
}

export function useRuns(pollInterval = 30_000) {
  const [runs, setRuns] = useState([])
  const loadRef = useRef(null)

  useEffect(() => {
    const load = () =>
      fetch('/api/runs')
        .then(r => r.json())
        .then(setRuns)
        .catch(() => {})

    loadRef.current = load
    load()

    // SSE for instant updates when a run completes — EventSource auto-reconnects
    const es = new EventSource('/api/runs/stream')
    es.onmessage = () => load()

    // Polling as safety net in case SSE drops silently
    const id = setInterval(load, pollInterval)

    return () => {
      es.close()
      clearInterval(id)

+## Run 92 — 2026-07-03 — RESEARCH
+
+**What I investigated:** Pi Pulse incubator-host reliability around run parsing, API JSON boundaries, per-incubator local Ollama/Qwen feedback, and runner preflight behavior.
+**Key finding:** `parseStdoutRunBlocks()` treats any stdout body containing `[run failed` as failed; live `/api/runs` therefore reports a successful Codex stdout block for run 89 as `FAILED` because the transcript/log text contains that marker elsewhere.
+**Implication:** The next build run should tighten failure classification before adding more history UI, otherwise the timeline can confidently display false failures.
+**Suggested next move:** Change stdout failure detection to anchor on the first meaningful stdout line, then verify `/api/runs` no longer reports `FAILED #89` for `[run completed successfully...]` while still preserving real `codex exited 127` failures.

 # Backlog
 
+## Run parser should anchor stdout failure detection
+`parseStdoutRunBlocks()` currently uses `body.includes('[run failed')`, which means a successful Codex transcript can become `FAILED` if it quotes earlier log text or a diff containing that marker. Live evidence on 2026-07-03: `/api/runs` reported `FAILED #89` with the summary `[run completed successfully; verbose Codex transcript omitted...]`. Change detection to inspect the first meaningful stdout line, e.g. `lines[0]?.startsWith('[run failed')`, and keep quoted historical failures out of the status classifier.
+
 ## ghost/whisper/oracle as incubated project
 The quartet (src/ghost/) is dormant — 5 standalone JS files, ports 3032–3036. Per the seed, it must NOT be integrated into Pi Pulse's Pulse tab UI. The correct pattern: create `projects/ghost-trio/status.json` with repo/runLog/runScript fields, point `mounted.json` at it, restart pi-pulse. Then the quartet gets its own ProjectPanel slot and run history without touching the waveform layer. One status.json + one run script = fully mounted. This is the right way to continue the ghost/oracle work without violating the "no new instruments" rule.

Live evidence on 2026-07-03: `/api/runs` reported `FAILED #89` with the summary `[run completed successfully; verbose Codex transcript omitted...]`. Change detection to inspect the first meaningful stdout line, e.g. `lines[0]?.startsWith('[run failed')`, and keep quoted historical failures out of the status classifier.
+
 ## ghost/whisper/oracle as incubated project
 The quartet (src/ghost/) is dormant — 5 standalone JS files, ports 3032–3036. Per the seed, it must NOT be integrated into Pi Pulse's Pulse tab UI. The correct pattern: create `projects/ghost-trio/status.json` with repo/runLog/runScript fields, point `mounted.json` at it, restart pi-pulse. Then the quartet gets its own ProjectPanel slot and run history without touching the waveform layer. One status.json + one run script = fully mounted. This is the right way to continue the ghost/oracle work without violating the "no new instruments" rule.

+
+**What I investigated:** Pi Pulse incubator-host reliability around run parsing, API JSON boundaries, per-incubator local Ollama/Qwen feedback, and runner preflight behavior.
+**Key finding:** `parseStdoutRunBlocks()` treats any stdout body containing `[run failed` as failed; live `/api/runs` therefore reports a successful Codex stdout block for run 89 as `FAILED` because the transcript/log text contains that marker elsewhere.

app.post('/api/reboot', (req, res) => {

// SSE — push 'update' to all connected clients whenever RUN_LOG.md changes
const runClients = new Set()
// Directory watch instead of file watch — survives rename-replace (new inode)
// and a log that doesn't exist yet. Filter to RUN_LOG.md so the rest of the
// lab dir's churn (MEMORY_BRIEF.md, ACTIVE_THREADS.md, …) doesn't spam clients.
try {
  fs.watch(dirname(RUN_LOG_PATH), { persistent: false }, (eventType, filename) => {
    if (filename && filename !== 'RUN_LOG.md') return
    syncProjectStatus()
    for (const client of runClients) {
      try { client.write('data: update\n\n') } catch { runClients.delete(client) }
    }
  })
} catch { /* lab dir missing would be fatal elsewhere anyway */ }

app.get('/api/runs/stream', (req, res) => {
  res.setHeader('Content-Type', 'text/event-stream')
  res.setHeader('Cache-Control', 'no-cache')
  res.setHeader('Connection', 'keep-alive')
  res.flushHeaders()
  runClients.add(res)
  const heartbeat = setInterval(() => {
    try { res.write(':heartbeat\n\n') } catch { clearInterval(heartbeat) }
  }, 25000)
  req.on('close', () => {
    runClients.delete(res)
    clearInterval(heartbeat)
  })
})

function startServer(retries = 10) {
  const server = app.listen(PORT, () => {
    console.log(`Pi Pulse API → http://localhost:${PORT}/api/stats`)
  })
  server.on('error', (err) => {
    if (err.code === 'EADDRINUSE' && retries > 0) {
      console.log(`[pi-pulse] port ${PORT} busy, retrying in 1s... (${retries} left)`)
      setTimeout(() => startServer(retries - 1), 1000)
    } else {
      console.error('[pi-pulse] fatal listen error:', err.message)
      process.exit(1)
    }
  })
}
startServer()

+function parseFormalRunBlocks(content) {
+  const runs = []

+  let searchFrom = 0
+  for (const block of sections) {
+    const order = content.indexOf(block, searchFrom)

+    const lines = block.split('\n')
+    const header = lines[0].replace('## Run ', '').trim()
+    const parts = header.split(/\s+[—-]\s+/).map(s => s.trim())
+    const [num, date, type] = parts
+    const fields = {}

+      if (line.startsWith('<!--')) break

+    }
+    const n = parseInt(num) || 0

+  }

+  }
+})
+
+function feedbackPathsForIncubator(cfg) {
+  if (cfg.project === 'pi-pulse') {
+    return {
+      json: '/home/admin/lab/DRIFT_FEEDBACK.json',
+      md: '/home/admin/lab/DRIFT_FEEDBACK.md',
+    }
+  }
+  const memoryDir = join(cfg.repo, 'memory')
+  if (fs.existsSync(memoryDir)) {
+    return {
+      json: join(memoryDir, 'DRIFT_FEEDBACK.json'),
+      md: join(memoryDir, 'DRIFT_FEEDBACK.md'),
+    }
+  }
+  return {
+    json: join(cfg.repo, 'reports', 'DRIFT_FEEDBACK.json'),
+    md: join(cfg.repo, 'reports', 'DRIFT_FEEDBACK.md'),
+  }
+}
+
+function aiTargetForIncubator(id) {
+  if (id === 'core') {
+    return {
+      id: 'core',
+      project: 'pi-pulse',
+      runLog: RUN_LOG_PATH,
+      paths: feedbackPathsForIncubator({ project: 'pi-pulse' }),
+      query: 'pi-pulse incubator host seed direction active threads',
+    }
+  }
+
+  const slot = readIncubators().slots.find(s => s.id === id)
+  if (!slot) return null
+  let cfg
+  try { cfg = readStatusAt(slot.statusPath) } catch { return null }
+  return {
+    id: slot.id,
+    project: cfg.project,
+    runLog: cfg.runLog,
+    paths: feedbackPathsForIncubator(cfg),
+    query: `${cfg.project} seed direction active threads`,
+  }
+}
+
+app.get('/api/incubators/:id/ai/latest', (req, res) => {
+  const target = aiTargetForIncubator(req.params.id)
+  if (!target) return res.status(404).json({ ok: false, error: 'incubator not found' })
+  try {
+    const data = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(target.paths.json, 'utf8'))
+    res.json({
+      ...data,
+      incubatorId: data.incubatorId ?? target.id,
+      project: data.project ?? target.project,
+      source: data.source ?? 'local-ollama-qwen',
+    })
+  } catch {
+    res.json({ ok: false })
+  }
+})
+
+app.post('/api/incubators/:id/ai/analyze', async (req, res) => {
+  const target = aiTargetForIncubator(req.params.id)
+  if (!target) return res.status(404).json({ ok: false, error: 'incubator not found' })
+  try {
+    const palaceCtx = queryMemPalace(target.query, { wing: 'lab', results: 3, maxChars: 600 })
+    let recentLog = ''
+    try { recentLog = fs.readFileSync(target.runLog, 'utf8').slice(-400) } catch {}
+
+    const prompt = `You are a local Ollama/Qwen critic analyzing an evolving software incubator.
+
+CONTEXT (from memory palace):
+${palaceCtx || '(unavailable)'}
+
+RECENT RUN LOG (tail):
+${recentLog}
+
+Respond in this exact format (5 lines, no extra text):
+DIRECTION: <one sentence on where the project is heading>
+STRONGEST: <what is working best right now>
+WEAKEST: <what is hurting the project most>
+DRIFT: <yes/no - is it drifting from the seed? why>
+NEXT: <the single most useful next action>`
+
+    const r = await fetch(`${HAILO_URL}/api/generate`, {
+      method: 'POST',
+      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
+      body: JSON.stringify({ model: AI_MODEL, prompt, stream: false }),
+      signal: AbortSignal.timeout(60000),
+    })
+    if (!r.ok) return res.status(502).json({ ok: false, error: await r.text() })
+
+    const data = await r.json()
+    try {

+      const ts = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 16).replace('T', ' ')
+      fs.writeFileSync(target.paths.md, `# Local Ollama/Qwen Feedback - ${ts}\n\n${data.response.trim()}\n`)
+      fs.writeFileSync(target.paths.json, JSON.stringify({
+        ok: true,
+        incubatorId: target.id,
+        project: target.project,
+        response: data.response,
+        model: AI_MODEL,
+        source: 'local-ollama-qwen',
+        ts: Date.now(),
+      }))
+    } catch { /* non-fatal */ }
+
+    res.json({ ok: true, incubatorId: target.id, project: target.project, response: data.response, model: AI_MODEL, source: 'local-ollama-qwen' })
+  } catch (err) {
+    res.status(500).json({ ok: false, error: err.message })
+  }
+})
+

+
+## Run 93 — 2026-07-03 — MUTATE
+
+**What I changed:** Tightened stdout-only run parsing so `FAILED` is assigned only when the first meaningful runner line starts with `[run failed]`, while real failures still include the command error detail.
+**Why:** The seed called for failed stdout-only runs to be visible with real errors, but the existing parser could also create false failures when successful transcripts merely quoted `[run failed]`.
+**What improved:** `/api/runs` no longer reports the run 89 successful stdout transcript as `FAILED`, and a real `[run failed: codex exited 127]` block still surfaces `bash: codex: command not found`.
+**What broke:** Full failure transcripts are still summarized to one detail line, so long command errors need a better drill-down surface.
+**Next move:** Add an expandable failure detail view in the Core incubator history that shows the preserved stdout error context without overwhelming the compact timeline.

+    return [parseFloat(parts[0]), parseFloat(parts[1]), parseFloat(parts[2])]
+  } catch {
+    return os.loadavg()
+  }
+}
+
+function formatUptime(seconds) {
+  const d = Math.floor(seconds / 86400)
+  const h = Math.floor((seconds % 86400) / 3600)
+  const m = Math.floor((seconds % 3600) / 60)
+  if (d > 0) return `${d}d ${h}h`
+  if (h > 0) return `${h}h ${m}m`
+  return `${m}m`
+}
+
+function getDiskInfo() {
+  try {
+    const out = execSync('df -B1 / 2>/dev/null', { timeout: 3000 }).toString().trim()
+    const lines = out.split('\n')
+    if (lines.length < 2) return null
+    const parts = lines[1].trim().split(/\s+/)
+    const total = parseInt(parts[1])
+    const used = parseInt(parts[2])
+    const pct = parseInt(parts[4])
+    return {
+      totalGB: (total / 1e9).toFixed(1),
+      usedGB: (used / 1e9).toFixed(1),
+      percent: isNaN(pct) ? 0 : pct,
+    }
+  } catch {
+    return null
+  }
+}
+
+function getNetworkRate() {
+  try {
+    const raw = fs.readFileSync('/proc/net/dev', 'utf8')
+    const lines = raw.trim().split('\n').slice(2)
+    const SKIP = /^(lo|docker|veth|br-|vmnet|virbr)/
+    let best = null
+    for (const line of lines) {
+      const colonIdx = line.indexOf(':')
+      if (colonIdx < 0) continue
+      const iface = line.slice(0, colonIdx).trim()
+      if (SKIP.test(iface)) continue
+      const fields = line.slice(colonIdx + 1).trim().split(/\s+/).map(Number)
+      const rx = fields[0]  // receive bytes
+      const tx = fields[8]  // transmit bytes
+      if (!best || rx > best.rx) best = { iface, rx, tx, ts: Date.now() }
+    }
+    if (!best) return { rx: 0, tx: 0, iface: 'unknown' }
+    if (!prevNetSample || best.iface !== prevNetSample.iface) {
+      prevNetSample = best
+      return { rx: 0, tx: 0, iface: best.iface }
+    }
+    const dt = (best.ts - prevNetSample.ts) / 1000
+    const rx = dt > 0 ? Math.max(0, Math.round((best.rx - prevNetSample.rx) / dt)) : 0
+    const tx = dt > 0 ? Math.max(0, Math.round((best.tx - prevNetSample.tx) / dt)) : 0
+    prevNetSample = best
+    return { rx, tx, iface: best.iface }
+  } catch {
+    return { rx: 0, tx: 0, iface: 'unknown' }
+  }
+}

+import { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react'
+import { motion } from 'framer-motion'
+
+const KEY_MAP = {
+  DIRECTION: ['direction', 'dir', 'duration', 'heading'],
+  STRONGEST: ['strongest', 'strong', 'best', 'winning'],
+  WEAKEST:   ['weakest', 'weak', 'worst', 'problem'],
+  DRIFT:     ['drift', 'drifting'],
+  NEXT:      ['next', 'mutate', 'suggested', 'suggestion', 'move', 'priority'],
+}
+
+function parseAnalysis(text) {
+  const fields = {}
+  const cleaned = text.replace(/\*\*/g, '').replace(/\r/g, '')
+  const re = /([A-Z]{2,}[A-Z\s]*):\s*\n?([\s\S]*?)(?=\n[A-Z]{2,}[A-Z\s]*:|$)/g
+  let m
+  while ((m = re.exec(cleaned)) !== null) {
+    const rawKey = m[1].trim().toLowerCase()
+    const value = m[2].trim().replace(/\n+/g, ' ')
+    if (!value) continue
+    for (const [canonical, aliases] of Object.entries(KEY_MAP)) {
+      if (aliases.some(a => rawKey.includes(a))) {
+        fields[canonical] = value
+        break
+      }
+    }
+  }
+  return fields
+}
+
+const FIELD_META = [

+  { key: 'NEXT',      label: 'Next move', color: '#38bdf8' },
+]

+function applyAccent({ accent, dim, glow }) {
+  const r = document.documentElement.style

+// Circadian ambient — bloom opacity and vertical position follow the time of day.
+// Night: dim and receded. Dawn: rising. Day: full presence. Dusk: fading.
+function useCircadian() {
+  const compute = () => {
+    const h = new Date().getHours() + new Date().getMinutes() / 60
+    if (h >= 22 || h < 5) return { opacity: 0.07, top: '-6vh' }   // deep night — receded
+    if (h < 8) {                                                    // dawn — rising
+      const p = (h - 5) / 3
+      return { opacity: 0.07 + p * 0.09, top: `${(-6 + p * 6).toFixed(1)}vh` }
+    }
+    if (h < 18) return { opacity: 0.16, top: '0vh' }               // day — full presence
+    const p = (h - 18) / 4                                         // dusk — fading
+    return { opacity: 0.16 - p * 0.09, top: `${(-p * 6).toFixed(1)}vh` }
+  }
+  const [state, setState] = useState(compute)
+  useEffect(() => {
+    const id = setInterval(() => setState(compute()), 60_000)
+    return () => clearInterval(id)
+  }, [])
+  return state

+function parseStdoutRunBlocks(content, byNum, { legacyOffset = false } = {}) {
+  const stdoutRe = /^\s*<!--\s*stdout from (codex\s+)?run (\d+)\s+(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})[^>]*-->([\s\S]*?)(?=^\s*<!--\s*stdout from (?:codex\s+)?run \d|^\s*## Run \d|$(?![\s\S]))/gm
+  let m
+  while ((m = stdoutRe.exec(content)) !== null) {
+    const [, codexMarker, slotStr, date, body] = m
+    const failed = body.includes('[run failed')
+    const boldRun = body.match(/\*\*Run (\d+)\s*(?:[—-]\s*([\w ]+?)\s*[—-]|\s*[—-]\s*done)/)
+    const num = boldRun ? parseInt(boldRun[1]) : parseInt(slotStr) + (!codexMarker && legacyOffset ? 1 : 0)
+    if (!num) continue
+
+    const rawType = boldRun?.[2]?.trim().toUpperCase() || ''
+    const type = failed ? 'FAILED' : ['MUTATE','RESEARCH','CREATE','RUN'].find(t => rawType.includes(t)) || rawType || 'RUN'
+    const lines = body.split('\n').map(l => l.trim()).filter(Boolean)
+    const failureLine = lines.find(l => l.startsWith('[run failed'))
+    const detailLine = lines.find(l =>
+      !l.startsWith('[run failed') &&
+      !l.startsWith('**Run') &&
+      !l.startsWith('---') &&
+      !l.startsWith('```')
+    )
+    const summary = failed
+      ? [failureLine, detailLine].filter(Boolean).join(' ')
+      : detailLine || ''
+
+    const existing = byNum.get(num)
+    const placeholder = existing?.type === 'RUN' && existing?.['What I changed'] === 'stdout captured with no summary'
+    if (!existing || (failed && placeholder)) {
+      byNum.set(num, { num, date, type, 'What I changed': summary || 'stdout captured with no summary' })
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+function parseFormalRunBlocks(content) {
+  const byNum = new Map()
+  const sections = content.split(/(?=^## Run \d)/m).filter(s => s.trimStart().startsWith('## Run'))
+  for (const block of sections) {
+    const lines = block.split('\n')
+    const header = lines[0].replace('## Run ', '').trim()
+    const parts = header.split(/\s+[—-]\s+/).map(s => s.trim())
+    const [num, date, type] = parts
+    const fields = {}
+    for (const line of lines.slice(1)) {
+      if (line.startsWith('<!--')) break
+      const m = line.match(/^\*\*(.+?):\*\*\s*(.+)/)
+      if (m) fields[m[1]] = m[2]
+    }
+    const n = parseInt(num) || 0
+    if (n) byNum.set(n, { num: n, date, type, ...fields })
+  }
+  return byNum
+}
+
+function parseRunsFromLog(content, options = {}) {
+  const byNum = parseFormalRunBlocks(content)
+  parseStdoutRunBlocks(content, byNum, options)
+  return [...byNum.values()].sort((a, b) => a.num - b.num)
+}
+
+app.get('/api/runs', (req, res) => {
+  try {
+    const content = fs.readFileSync('/home/admin/lab/RUN_LOG.md', 'utf8')
+    res.json(parseRunsFromLog(content, { legacyOffset: true }).slice(-10))
+  } catch {
+    res.json([])
+  }
+})
+

+export function useSystemStats() {

+        if (demoIntervalRef.current) {

+          demoIntervalRef.current = null
+        }
+        setHistory(h => [...h, data.cpu].slice(-80))
+        if (data.temperature != null) {
+          setTempHistory(h => [...h, data.temperature].slice(-80))
+        }
+        if (data.net != null) {
+          setNetRxHistory(h => [...h, data.net.rx].slice(-80))

+      } catch { /* malformed event — ignore */ }

+            setNetRxHistory(h => [...h, demo.net.rx].slice(-80))

+    }

+    return () => {

+      }
+    }

+  return { stats, history, tempHistory, netRxHistory, netTxHistory, isDemo, connected }

+  const refresh = useCallback(() => { loadRef.current?.() }, [])
+
+  return [runs, refresh]

+**What improved:** Core now exposes its saved local Ollama/Qwen feedback through the same incubator strip as projects, switching cards no longer consumes an old trigger as a fresh analysis request, and bad API paths no longer fall through to `index.html`.
+**What broke:** Auto-analysis still keys off parsed run-list length, so repeated stdout blocks with the same parsed run number may not retrigger feedback.
+**Next move:** Track a stable per-incubator latest-run signature instead of list length so failed repeated runs and same-number stdout blocks can trigger one fresh local analysis.
+

+const runClients = new Set()

+// lab dir's churn (MEMORY_BRIEF.md, ACTIVE_THREADS.md, …) doesn't spam clients.
+try {
+  fs.watch(dirname(RUN_LOG_PATH), { persistent: false }, (eventType, filename) => {
+    if (filename && filename !== 'RUN_LOG.md') return
+    syncProjectStatus()
+    for (const client of runClients) {
+      try { client.write('data: update\n\n') } catch { runClients.delete(client) }
+    }
+  })

+function summarizeRun(run) {
+  return run['Failure'] || run['Error'] || run['Goal'] || run['Done'] ||
+    run['What I investigated'] || run['Investigated'] || run['What I built'] ||
+    run['What I changed'] || run['What improved'] || run['What I found'] ||
+    run['Key finding'] || run['Suggested next move'] || ''
+}
+
+function publicRun(run) {
+  const { _order, _source, ...rest } = run
+  return rest
+}
+
+function runSignature(run) {
+  return [
+    run._source ?? 'run',
+    run._order ?? 0,
+    run.num ?? '',
+    run.date ?? '',
+    run.type ?? '',
+    summarizeRun(run),
+  ].join('|')
+}
+
+function parseStdoutRunBlocks(content, runs, { legacyOffset = false } = {}) {
+  const stdoutRe = /^\s*<!--\s*stdout from (codex\s+)?run (\d+)\s+(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})[^>]*-->([\s\S]*?)(?=^\s*<!--\s*stdout from (?:codex\s+)?run \d|^\s*## Run \d|$(?![\s\S]))/gm
+  let m
+  while ((m = stdoutRe.exec(content)) !== null) {
+    const [, codexMarker, slotStr, date, body] = m
+    const failed = body.includes('[run failed')
+    const boldRun = body.match(/\*\*Run (\d+)\s*(?:[—-]\s*([\w ]+?)\s*[—-]|\s*[—-]\s*done)/)
+    const num = boldRun ? parseInt(boldRun[1]) : parseInt(slotStr) + (!codexMarker && legacyOffset ? 1 : 0)
+    if (!num) continue
+
+    const rawType = boldRun?.[2]?.trim().toUpperCase() || ''
+    const type = failed ? 'FAILED' : ['MUTATE','RESEARCH','CREATE','RUN'].find(t => rawType.includes(t)) || rawType || 'RUN'
+    const lines = body.split('\n').map(l => l.trim()).filter(Boolean)
+    const failureLine = lines.find(l => l.startsWith('[run failed'))
+    const detailLine = lines.find(l =>
+      !l.startsWith('[run failed') &&
+      !l.startsWith('**Run') &&
+      !l.startsWith('---') &&
+      !l.startsWith('```')
+    )
+    const summary = failed
+      ? [failureLine, detailLine].filter(Boolean).join(' ')
+      : detailLine || ''
+
+    const formal = runs.find(r => r.num === num && r._source === 'formal')
+    if (formal && !failed) continue
+
+    const run = {
+      num,
+      date,
+      type,
+      'What I changed': summary || 'stdout captured with no summary',
+      _order: m.index,
+      _source: 'stdout',
+    }
+    run.signature = runSignature(run)
+    runs.push(run)
+  }
+}
+
+function parseFormalRunBlocks(content) {
+  const runs = []
+  const sections = content.split(/(?=^## Run \d)/m).filter(s => s.trimStart().startsWith('## Run'))
+  let searchFrom = 0
+  for (const block of sections) {
+    const order = content.indexOf(block, searchFrom)
+    if (order >= 0) searchFrom = order + block.length
+    const lines = block.split('\n')
+    const header = lines[0].replace('## Run ', '').trim()
+    const parts = header.split(/\s+[—-]\s+/).map(s => s.trim())
+    const [num, date, type] = parts
+    const fields = {}
+    for (const line of lines.slice(1)) {
+      if (line.startsWith('<!--')) break
+      const m = line.match(/^\*\*(.+?):\*\*\s*(.+)/)
+      if (m) fields[m[1]] = m[2]
+    }
+    const n = parseInt(num) || 0
+    if (n) {
+      const run = { num: n, date, type, ...fields, _order: order >= 0 ? order : runs.length, _source: 'formal' }
+      run.signature = runSignature(run)
+      runs.push(run)
+    }
+  }
+  return runs
+}

+function parseRunsFromLog(content, options = {}) {
+  const runs = parseFormalRunBlocks(content)
+  parseStdoutRunBlocks(content, runs, options)
+  return runs
+    .sort((a, b) => (a._order ?? 0) - (b._order ?? 0))
+    .map(publicRun)
+}

+function parseRunLog(content) {
+  const blocks = content.split(/(?=^## Run \d)/m).filter(s => s.trimStart().startsWith('## Run'))
+  return blocks.map(block => {
+    // Strip stdout comment dumps
+    const clean = block.replace(/<!--[\s\S]*?-->/g, '').replace(/\n{3,}/g, '\n\n').trim()
+    const lines = clean.split('\n')
+    const header = lines[0].replace('## Run ', '')
+    const parts = header.split(' — ').map(s => s.trim())
+    const num = parts[0], date = parts[1], type = parts[2]
+    const fields = []
+    for (const line of lines.slice(1)) {
+      const m = line.match(/^\*\*(.+?):\*\*\s*(.+)/)
+      if (m) fields.push({ label: m[1], value: m[2] })
+    }
+    return { num, date, type, fields }
+  }).reverse()
+}

+        {/* Header */}
+        <div style={{
+          padding: '14px 20px',
+          borderBottom: '1px solid var(--border)',
+          display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'space-between',
+          flexShrink: 0,
+        }}>
+          <span style={{ fontWeight: 600, fontSize: '0.8rem', color: '#e2e8f0', fontFamily: 'monospace', letterSpacing: '0.06em' }}>
+            Run Log
+          </span>
+          <button
+            onClick={onClose}
+            style={{ background: 'none', border: 'none', color: 'var(--muted)', cursor: 'pointer', fontSize: '1.2rem', lineHeight: 1 }}
+          >×</button>
+        </div>
+
+        {/* Cards */}
+        <div style={{ flex: 1, overflowY: 'auto', padding: '16px 20px', display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 12 }}>
+          {runs.map((run, i) => {
+            const tc = LOG_TYPE_COLOR[run.type] ?? '#64748b'
+            return (
+              <div key={i} style={{
+                background: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.03)',
+                border: '1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.07)',
+                borderRadius: 10,
+                padding: '12px 16px',
+              }}>

+                <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8, marginBottom: 10 }}>

+                    fontSize: '0.62rem', fontFamily: 'monospace', fontWeight: 700,
+                    color: tc, letterSpacing: '0.1em', textTransform: 'uppercase',
+                    background: `color-mix(in srgb, ${tc} 12%, transparent)`,
+                    padding: '2px 7px', borderRadius: 4, border: `1px solid color-mix(in srgb, ${tc} 25%, transparent)`,
+                  }}>{run.type}</span>
+                  <span style={{ fontSize: '0.7rem', fontFamily: 'monospace', color: '#e2e8f0', fontWeight: 600 }}>
+                    #{run.num}
+                  </span>
+                  {run.date && (
+                    <span style={{ fontSize: '0.65rem', fontFamily: 'monospace', color: 'var(--muted)', marginLeft: 'auto' }}>
+                      {run.date}
+                    </span>
+                  )}
+                </div>
+                {/* Fields */}
+                <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 6 }}>
+                  {run.fields.map((f, j) => (

+                        color: LOG_FIELD_COLOR[f.label] ?? '#64748b',

+                        minWidth: 90, flexShrink: 0, paddingTop: 2,

+                      <span style={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', lineHeight: 1.5, color: 'rgba(226,232,240,0.75)' }}>
+                        {f.value}
+                      </span>
+                    </div>
+                  ))}
+                </div>
+              </div>

+// ─── Secondary action button ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+function SecondaryButton({ label, description, icon, danger, onClick }) {
+  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false)
+  const color = danger ? '#f87171' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.55)'
+
+  const handle = async () => {
+    if (loading) return
+    setLoading(true)
+    try { await onClick?.() } finally {
+      setTimeout(() => setLoading(false), 700)
+    }
+  }
+
+  return (
+    <motion.button
+      whileHover={{ x: 2 }}
+      whileTap={{ scale: 0.98 }}
+      onClick={handle}
+      style={{
+        width: '100%', padding: '9px 12px',
+        borderRadius: 8,
+        border: '1px solid var(--border)',
+        background: 'transparent',
+        cursor: 'pointer',
+        display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10,
+        transition: 'background 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease',
+      }}
+      onMouseEnter={e => { e.currentTarget.style.background = 'var(--surface2)' }}
+      onMouseLeave={e => { e.currentTarget.style.background = 'transparent' }}
+    >
+      <div style={{ color, opacity: loading ? 0.5 : 1 }}>
+        {loading ? (
+          <motion.div animate={{ rotate: 360 }} transition={{ duration: 0.8, repeat: Infinity, ease: 'linear' }}>
+            <svg width="13" height="13" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2">
+              <path d="M21 12a9 9 0 11-6.219-8.56" strokeLinecap="round" />
+            </svg>
+          </motion.div>
+        ) : icon}
+      </div>
+      <div>
+        <div style={{ fontSize: '0.8rem', fontWeight: 500, color: danger ? '#f87171' : 'rgba(241,245,249,0.8)' }}>
+          {label}
+        </div>
+        <div style={{ fontSize: '0.68rem', color: 'rgba(71,85,105,0.7)' }}>{description}</div>

+// ─── Helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+
+function fmtElapsed(secs) {
+  if (!secs || secs < 1) return ''
+  const m = Math.floor(secs / 60)
+  const s = secs % 60
+  return m > 0 ? `${m}m ${s}s` : `${s}s`
+}
+
+function fmtAgo(ts) {
+  const mins = Math.floor((Date.now() - ts) / 60000)
+  if (mins < 1) return 'just now'
+  if (mins === 1) return '1 min ago'
+  if (mins < 60) return `${mins} min ago`
+  return `${Math.floor(mins / 60)}h ago`
+}
+

+        if (data.ok && data.text) setLatestNarration(data)
+      } catch {}
+    }
+    fetch_()
+    const id = setInterval(fetch_, 60_000)
+    return () => clearInterval(id)

+

+++## Run 91 — 2026-07-03 — MUTATE
+++
+++**What I changed:** Added duplicate-attempt metadata to parsed runs and rendered attempt suffixes plus `FAILED` styling in the host and incubator timelines.
+++**Why:** The seed called for failed stdout-only runs to be visible, but repeated same-number failures still looked like the same event in history.
+++**What improved:** Failed retries now keep stable signatures, show as distinct timeline entries, and display `attempt n/total` when the log contains repeated run numbers.
+++**What broke:** The underlying log still allows repeated run numbers; this only makes the ambiguity visible instead of preventing it.
+++**Next move:** Add a runner preflight status row that checks missing binaries like `codex` before scheduled incubator runs fire.

+++**What I changed:** Added duplicate-attempt metadata to parsed runs and rendered attempt suffixes plus `FAILED` styling in the host and incubator timelines.

+++**What I changed:** Added duplicate-attempt metadata to parsed runs and rendered attempt suffixes plus `FAILED` styling in the host and incubator timelines.
+++**Why:** The seed called for failed stdout-only runs to be visible, but repeated same-number failures still looked like the same event in history.
+++**What improved:** Failed retries now keep stable signatures, show as distinct timeline entries, and display `attempt n/total` when the log contains repeated run numbers.
+++**What broke:** The underlying log still allows repeated run numbers; this only makes the ambiguity visible instead of preventing it.
+++**Next move:** Add a runner preflight status row that checks missing binaries like `codex` before scheduled incubator runs fire.

++## Run 92 — 2026-07-03 — RESEARCH
++
++**What I investigated:** Pi Pulse incubator-host reliability around run parsing, API JSON boundaries, per-incubator local Ollama/Qwen feedback, and runner preflight behavior.
++**Key finding:** `parseStdoutRunBlocks()` treats any stdout body containing `[run failed` as failed; live `/api/runs` therefore reports a successful Codex stdout block for run 89 as `FAILED` because the transcript/log text contains that marker elsewhere.
++**Implication:** The next build run should tighten failure classification before adding more history UI, otherwise the timeline can confidently display false failures.
++**Suggested next move:** Change stdout failure detection to anchor on the first meaningful stdout line, then verify `/api/runs` no longer reports `FAILED #89` for `[run completed successfully...]` while still preserving real `codex exited 127` failures.

+## Run 93 — 2026-07-03 — MUTATE
+
+**What I changed:** Tightened stdout-only run parsing so `FAILED` is assigned only when the first meaningful runner line starts with `[run failed]`, while real failures still include the command error detail.
+**Why:** The seed called for failed stdout-only runs to be visible with real errors, but the existing parser could also create false failures when successful transcripts merely quoted `[run failed]`.
+**What improved:** `/api/runs` no longer reports the run 89 successful stdout transcript as `FAILED`, and a real `[run failed: codex exited 127]` block still surfaces `bash: codex: command not found`.
+**What broke:** Full failure transcripts are still summarized to one detail line, so long command errors need a better drill-down surface.
+**Next move:** Add an expandable failure detail view in the Core incubator history that shows the preserved stdout error context without overwhelming the compact timeline.

+function parseFormalRunBlocks(content) {
+  const runs = []
+  const sections = content.split(/(?=^## Run \d)/m).filter(s => s.trimStart().startsWith('## Run'))
+  let searchFrom = 0
+  for (const block of sections) {
+    const order = content.indexOf(block, searchFrom)
+    if (order >= 0) searchFrom = order + block.length
+    const lines = block.split('\n')
+    const header = lines[0].replace('## Run ', '').trim()
+    const parts = header.split(/\s+[—-]\s+/).map(s => s.trim())
+    const [num, date, type] = parts
+    const fields = {}
+    for (const line of lines.slice(1)) {
+      if (line.startsWith('<!--')) break
+      const m = line.match(/^\*\*(.+?):\*\*\s*(.+)/)
+      if (m) fields[m[1]] = m[2]
+    }
+    const n = parseInt(num) || 0
+    if (n) {
+      const run = { num: n, date, type, ...fields, _order: order >= 0 ? order : runs.length, _source: 'formal' }
+      run.signature = runSignature(run)
+      runs.push(run)
     }
+  }
+  return runs
+}

+  const seen = new Map()

+    const key = `${run.num ?? ''}|${run.date ?? ''}`
+    const attemptTotal = totals.get(key) ?? 1
+    if (attemptTotal <= 1) return run
+
+    const attempt = (seen.get(key) ?? 0) + 1
+    seen.set(key, attempt)
+    run._attemptKey = key
+    run.attempt = attempt
+    run.attemptTotal = attemptTotal
+    run.signature = `${run.signature}|attempt:${attempt}/${attemptTotal}`
+    return run
+  })
+}
+
+function parseRunsFromLog(content, options = {}) {
+  const runs = parseFormalRunBlocks(content)
+  parseStdoutRunBlocks(content, runs, options)
+  const sortedRuns = runs.sort((a, b) => (a._order ?? 0) - (b._order ?? 0))
+  return annotateRunAttempts(sortedRuns).map(publicRun)
+}

+function readStatusAt(statusPath) {

+function hydrateIncubator(slot) {

+  try { repoStatus = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(repoStatusPath, 'utf8')) } catch {}
+  const running = getIncubatorRun(slot.id)

+    phase: cfg.phase ?? repoStatus.phase ?? null,

+    runLog: cfg.runLog,
+    playUrl: fs.existsSync(join(cfg.repo, 'index.html'))
+      ? `/${cfg.project.replace(/[^a-z0-9_-]/gi, '-').toLowerCase()}/`
+      : null,
+    runCount: cfg.runCount ?? repoStatus.runCount ?? 0,
+    lastRun: cfg.lastRun ?? repoStatus.lastRun ?? null,
+    lastRunType: cfg.lastRunType ?? repoStatus.lastRunType ?? null,
+    availableRunners: [

+}
+
+function getIncubatorRun(id) {
+  const run = activeIncubatorRuns.get(id)
+  if (!run) return { running: false, pid: null, elapsed: 0, startTime: null }
+  try {
+    process.kill(run.pid, 0)
+    return {
+      running: true,
+      pid: run.pid,
+      elapsed: Math.floor((Date.now() - run.startTime) / 1000),
+      startTime: run.startTime,
+      runner: run.runner,
+    }
+  } catch {

+    return { running: false, pid: null, elapsed: 0, startTime: null }
+  }

+
+function startIncubatorRun(slot, runType = null) {
+  const alive = getIncubatorRun(slot.id)
+  if (alive.running) return { alreadyRunning: true, ...alive }
+  const cfg = readStatusAt(slot.statusPath)
+  if (!cfg.runScript || !fs.existsSync(cfg.runScript)) return null
+  const args = [cfg.runScript]
+  if (cfg.runner === 'codex' || cfg.runScript.includes('run-codex-incubator.sh')) {

+function claudeRunScriptForProject(project) {

+  } else if (runner === 'claude') {

+## Run 93 — 2026-07-03 — MUTATE
+
+**What I changed:** Tightened stdout-only run parsing so `FAILED` is assigned only when the first meaningful runner line starts with `[run failed]`, while real failures still include the command error detail.
+**Why:** The seed called for failed stdout-only runs to be visible with real errors, but the existing parser could also create false failures when successful transcripts merely quoted `[run failed]`.
+**What improved:** `/api/runs` no longer reports the run 89 successful stdout transcript as `FAILED`, and a real `[run failed: codex exited 127]` block still surfaces `bash: codex: command not found`.
+**What broke:** Full failure transcripts are still summarized to one detail line, so long command errors need a better drill-down surface.
+**Next move:** Add an expandable failure detail view in the Core incubator history that shows the preserved stdout error context without overwhelming the compact timeline.
+

+**What broke:** Full failure transcripts are still summarized to one detail line, so long command errors need a better drill-down surface.
+**Next move:** Add an expandable failure detail view in the Core incubator history that shows the preserved stdout error context without overwhelming the compact timeline.
+

+**Why:** The seed called for failed stdout-only runs to be visible with real errors, but the existing parser could also create false failures when successful transcripts merely quoted `[run failed]`.
+**What improved:** `/api/runs` no longer reports the run 89 successful stdout transcript as `FAILED`, and a real `[run failed: codex exited 127]` block still surfaces `bash: codex: command not found`.
+**What broke:** Full failure transcripts are still summarized to one detail line, so long command errors need a better drill-down surface.
+**Next move:** Add an expandable failure detail view in the Core incubator history that shows the preserved stdout error context without overwhelming the compact timeline.

function feedbackPathsForIncubator(cfg) {
  if (cfg.project === 'pi-pulse') {
    return {
      json: '/home/admin/lab/DRIFT_FEEDBACK.json',
      md: '/home/admin/lab/DRIFT_FEEDBACK.md',
    }
  }
  const memoryDir = join(cfg.repo, 'memory')
  if (fs.existsSync(memoryDir)) {
    return {
      json: join(memoryDir, 'DRIFT_FEEDBACK.json'),
      md: join(memoryDir, 'DRIFT_FEEDBACK.md'),
    }
  }
  return {
    json: join(cfg.repo, 'reports', 'DRIFT_FEEDBACK.json'),
    md: join(cfg.repo, 'reports', 'DRIFT_FEEDBACK.md'),
  }
}

function aiTargetForIncubator(id) {
  if (id === 'core') {
    return {
      id: 'core',
      project: 'pi-pulse',
      runLog: RUN_LOG_PATH,
      paths: feedbackPathsForIncubator({ project: 'pi-pulse' }),
      query: 'pi-pulse incubator host seed direction active threads',
    }
  }

  const slot = readIncubators().slots.find(s => s.id === id)
  if (!slot) return null
  let cfg
  try { cfg = readStatusAt(slot.statusPath) } catch { return null }
  return {
    id: slot.id,
    project: cfg.project,
    runLog: cfg.runLog,
    paths: feedbackPathsForIncubator(cfg),
    query: `${cfg.project} seed direction active threads`,
  }
}

app.get('/api/incubators/:id/ai/latest', (req, res) => {
  const target = aiTargetForIncubator(req.params.id)
  if (!target) return res.status(404).json({ ok: false, error: 'incubator not found' })
  try {
    const data = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(target.paths.json, 'utf8'))
    res.json({
      ...data,
      incubatorId: data.incubatorId ?? target.id,
      project: data.project ?? target.project,
      source: data.source ?? 'local-ollama-qwen',
    })
  } catch {
    res.json({ ok: false })
  }
})

app.post('/api/incubators/:id/ai/analyze', async (req, res) => {
  const target = aiTargetForIncubator(req.params.id)
  if (!target) return res.status(404).json({ ok: false, error: 'incubator not found' })
  try {
    const palaceCtx = queryMemPalace(target.query, { wing: 'lab', results: 3, maxChars: 600 })
    let recentLog = ''
    try { recentLog = fs.readFileSync(target.runLog, 'utf8').slice(-400) } catch {}

    const prompt = `You are a local Ollama/Qwen critic analyzing an evolving software incubator.

CONTEXT (from memory palace):
${palaceCtx || '(unavailable)'}

RECENT RUN LOG (tail):
${recentLog}

Respond in this exact format (5 lines, no extra text):
DIRECTION: <one sentence on where the project is heading>
STRONGEST: <what is working best right now>
WEAKEST: <what is hurting the project most>
DRIFT: <yes/no - is it drifting from the seed? why>
NEXT: <the single most useful next action>`

    const r = await fetch(`${HAILO_URL}/api/generate`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ model: AI_MODEL, prompt, stream: false }),
      signal: AbortSignal.timeout(60000),
    })
    if (!r.ok) return res.status(502).json({ ok: false, error: await r.text() })

    const data = await r.json()
    try {
      fs.mkdirSync(dirname(target.paths.json), { recursive: true })
      const ts = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 16).replace('T', ' ')
      fs.writeFileSync(target.paths.md, `# Local Ollama/Qwen Feedback - ${ts}\n\n${data.response.trim()}\n`)
      fs.writeFileSync(target.paths.json, JSON.stringify({
        ok: true,
        incubatorId: target.id,
        project: target.project,
        response: data.response,
        model: AI_MODEL,
        source: 'local-ollama-qwen',
        ts: Date.now(),
      }))
    } catch { /* non-fatal */ }

    res.json({ ok: true, incubatorId: target.id, project: target.project, response: data.response, model: AI_MODEL, source: 'local-ollama-qwen' })
  } catch (err) {
    res.status(500).json({ ok: false, error: err.message })
  }
})

// AI analysis via local Ollama/Qwen
const HAILO_URL = 'http://localhost:11434'
const AI_MODEL = 'qwen2.5-instruct:1.5b'

// MemPalace semantic search — returns relevant context snippets (~100-600 chars)
// instead of dumping raw files into every prompt
function queryMemPalace(query, { wing = '', results = 3, maxChars = 600 } = {}) {
  try {
    const wingFlag = wing ? `--wing ${wing}` : ''
    const raw = execSync(
      `/home/admin/.local/bin/mempalace search ${JSON.stringify(query)} --results ${results} ${wingFlag} 2>/dev/null`,
      { timeout: 10000, encoding: 'utf8', env: { ...process.env, HOME: '/home/admin' } }

import { useState, useEffect, useRef, useMemo } from 'react'
import { motion } from 'framer-motion'

// ─── AI analysis strip ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

const AI_FIELD_META = [
  { key: 'DIRECTION', label: 'Direction', color: 'var(--accent)' },
  { key: 'STRONGEST', label: 'Strongest', color: '#22c55e' },
  { key: 'WEAKEST',   label: 'Weakest',   color: '#f97316' },
  { key: 'DRIFT',     label: 'Drift',     color: '#a78bfa' },
  { key: 'NEXT',      label: 'Next',      color: '#38bdf8' },
]

function parseAnalysis(text) {
  const fields = {}
  const re = /([A-Z]{2,}[A-Z\s]*):\s*\n?([\s\S]*?)(?=\n[A-Z]{2,}[A-Z\s]*:|$)/g
  let m
  while ((m = re.exec(text.replace(/\*\*/g, '').replace(/\r/g, ''))) !== null) {
    const key = m[1].trim().toUpperCase()
    const val = m[2].trim().replace(/\n+/g, ' ')
    if (val && AI_FIELD_META.some(f => f.key === key)) fields[key] = val
  }
  return fields
}

function AiStrip({ slotId, autoTrigger }) {
  const [open, setOpen]         = useState(false)
  const [analysis, setAnalysis] = useState(null)
  const [loading, setLoading]   = useState(false)
  const [error, setError]       = useState(null)
  const [lastRun, setLastRun]   = useState(null)
  const prevTriggerBySlotRef    = useRef({})

  useEffect(() => {
    setAnalysis(null)
    setError(null)
    setLastRun(null)
    if (!slotId) return
    fetch(`/api/incubators/${slotId}/ai/latest`)
      .then(async r => {
        const text = await r.text()
        try { return JSON.parse(text) }
        catch { throw new Error('AI feedback API returned HTML, not JSON') }
      })
      .then(d => {
        if (d.ok && d.response) {
          setAnalysis(parseAnalysis(d.response))
          setLastRun(new Date(d.ts).toLocaleTimeString())
        }
      })
      .catch(err => setError(err.message))
  }, [slotId])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!slotId) return
    const prev = prevTriggerBySlotRef.current[slotId]
    if (prev == null) {
      prevTriggerBySlotRef.current[slotId] = autoTrigger
      return
    }
    if (autoTrigger > prev && !loading) {
      prevTriggerBySlotRef.current[slotId] = autoTrigger
      runAnalysis()
    } else if (autoTrigger > prev) {
      prevTriggerBySlotRef.current[slotId] = autoTrigger
    }
  }, [slotId, autoTrigger])

  async function runAnalysis(e) {
    e?.stopPropagation()
    setLoading(true)
    setError(null)
    setOpen(true)
    try {
      const r = await fetch(`/api/incubators/${slotId}/ai/analyze`, { method: 'POST' })
      const text = await r.text()
      let d
      try { d = JSON.parse(text) }
      catch { throw new Error('AI feedback API returned HTML, not JSON') }
      if (!d.ok) throw new Error(d.error || 'failed')
      setAnalysis(parseAnalysis(d.response))
      setLastRun(new Date().toLocaleTimeString())
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err.message)
    } finally {
      setLoading(false)
    }
  }

  const active = loading || !!analysis

  return (
    <>
      {/* Header strip */}
      <div
        role="button" tabIndex={0}
        onClick={() => setOpen(o => !o)}
        onKeyDown={e => { if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') setOpen(o => !o) }}
        style={{
          borderTop: active
            ? '1px solid color-mix(in srgb, #a78bfa 28%, transparent)'
            : '1px solid var(--border)',
          padding: '10px 24px', cursor: 'pointer',
          display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 8,
          background: active ? 'color-mix(in srgb, #a78bfa 3%, transparent)' : 'transparent',
          transition: 'background 0.5s ease, border-top-color 0.5s ease',
          position: 'relative', overflow: 'hidden',
        }}
        onMouseEnter={e => { e.currentTarget.style.background = active ? 'color-mix(in srgb, #a78bfa 5%, transparent)' : 'rgba(255,255,255,0.02)' }}
        onMouseLeave={e => { e.currentTarget.style.background = active ? 'color-mix(in srgb, #a78bfa 3%, transparent)' : 'transparent' }}
      >
        {loading && (
          <motion.div
            initial={{ x: '-100%' }} animate={{ x: '240%' }}
            transition={{ duration: 1.7, repeat: Infinity, ease: 'linear' }}
            style={{ position: 'absolute', top: 0, bottom: 0, left: 0, width: '42%',
              background: 'linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, color-mix(in srgb, #a78bfa 22%, transparent), transparent)',
              pointerEvents: 'none' }}
          />
        )}
        <span style={{ fontSize: '0.6rem', fontFamily: 'monospace', fontWeight: 600,
          textTransform: 'uppercase', letterSpacing: '0.12em',
          color: active ? '#a78bfa' : 'var(--muted)', position: 'relative' }}>
          Local Ollama
        </span>
        <motion.div
          animate={analysis ? { opacity: [1, 0.3, 1] } : {}}
          transition={{ duration: 1.8, repeat: Infinity, ease: 'easeInOut' }}
          style={{ width: 5, height: 5, borderRadius: '50%', background: error ? '#ef4444' : '#22c55e', flexShrink: 0 }}
        />
        <span style={{ flex: 1, fontSize: '0.67rem', fontFamily: 'monospace',
          color: !open && analysis?.DIRECTION ? 'rgba(241,245,249,0.55)' : 'rgba(71,85,105,0.4)',
          overflow: 'hidden', textOverflow: 'ellipsis', whiteSpace: 'nowrap' }}>
          {!open && analysis?.DIRECTION
            ? (analysis.DIRECTION.length > 60 ? analysis.DIRECTION.slice(0, 60) + '…' : analysis.DIRECTION)
            : !open && loading ? 'analyzing…' : !open ? 'ready' : ''}
        </span>
        <button onClick={e => { e.stopPropagation(); runAnalysis() }} disabled={loading}
          title="Refresh local Ollama/Qwen analysis"
          style={{ background: 'none', border: 'none', padding: '2px 4px', cursor: loading ? 'default' : 'pointer',
            opacity: loading ? 0.18 : 0.32, color: 'rgba(148,163,184,1)', display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center',
            transition: 'opacity 0.2s ease', flexShrink: 0 }}
          onMouseEnter={e => { if (!loading) e.currentTarget.style.opacity = '0.72' }}
          onMouseLeave={e => { e.currentTarget.style.opacity = loading ? '0.18' : '0.32' }}>
          <svg width="10" height="10" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="2.5" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round">
            <polyline points="23 4 23 10 17 10" /><path d="M20.49 15a9 9 0 11-2.12-9.36L23 10" />
          </svg>
        </button>
        <motion.svg animate={{ rotate: open ? 180 : 0 }} transition={{ duration: 0.2 }}
          width="10" height="10" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none"
          stroke="rgba(71,85,105,0.5)" strokeWidth="2.5" strokeLinecap="round" style={{ flexShrink: 0 }}>
          <polyline points="6 9 12 15 18 9" />
        </motion.svg>
      </div>

      {/* Collapsible body */}
      <motion.div
        initial={false}
        animate={{ height: open ? 'auto' : 0, opacity: open ? 1 : 0 }}
        transition={{ height: { duration: 0.22, ease: [0.4, 0, 0.2, 1] }, opacity: { duration: 0.15 } }}
        style={{ overflow: 'hidden' }}
      >
        <div style={{ padding: '4px 24px 16px' }}>
          {error && (
            <div style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 6, alignItems: 'center', padding: '5px 0 4px' }}>
              <div style={{ width: 5, height: 5, borderRadius: '50%', background: '#ef4444', flexShrink: 0 }} />
              <span style={{ fontSize: '0.7rem', fontFamily: 'monospace', color: 'rgba(248,113,113,0.8)' }}>{error}</span>
            </div>
          )}
          {AI_FIELD_META.map((f, i) => (
            <div key={f.key} style={{ display: 'flex', gap: 12, alignItems: loading ? 'center' : 'flex-start',
              padding: '6px 0', borderBottom: i < AI_FIELD_META.length - 1 ? '1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.04)' : 'none' }}>
              <span style={{ fontSize: '0.57rem', fontFamily: 'monospace', textTransform: 'uppercase',
                letterSpacing: '0.1em', fontWeight: 600, color: f.color,
                minWidth: 68, flexShrink: 0, opacity: (!analysis && !loading) ? 0.4 : 1 }}>
                {f.label}
              </span>
              {loading ? (
                <div className="animate-pulse" style={{ height: 7, flex: 1, background: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.07)', borderRadius: 3 }} />
              ) : (
                <span style={{ fontSize: '0.78rem', fontFamily: 'monospace', lineHeight: 1.5,
                  color: analysis?.[f.key] ? 'rgba(241,245,249,0.85)' : 'rgba(71,85,105,0.32)' }}>
                  {analysis?.[f.key] ?? '—'}
                </span>
              )}
            </div>
          ))}
          {lastRun && !loading && (
            <div style={{ paddingTop: 7, borderTop: '1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.04)', marginTop: 2 }}>
              <span style={{ fontSize: '0.59rem', fontFamily: 'monospace', color: 'rgba(71,85,105,0.45)' }}>
                saved {lastRun} · Qwen qwen2.5-instruct:1.5b
              </span>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </motion.div>
    </>
  )
}

const TYPE_COLOR = {
  MUTATE:   '#a78bfa',
  RESEARCH: '#34d399',
  CREATE:   '#22d3ee',
  FAILED:   '#f87171',
}

function fmtElapsed(secs) {
  const m = Math.floor(secs / 60)
  const s = secs % 60
  return m > 0 ? `${m}m ${s}s` : `${s}s`
}

function fmtCountdown(nextRunAt) {
  if (!nextRunAt) return null
  const diffMs = nextRunAt - Date.now()
  if (diffMs <= 0) return 'soon'
  const h = Math.floor(diffMs / 3600000)
  const m = Math.floor((diffMs % 3600000) / 60000)
  return h > 0 ? `${h}h ${m}m` : `${m}m`
}

function fmtInterval(hours) {
  if (!hours) return 'manual'
  const mins = Math.round(hours * 60)
  return mins < 60 ? `${mins}m` : `${hours}h`
}

function runAttemptText(run) {
  return run.attemptTotal > 1 && run.attempt ? ` · attempt ${run.attempt}/${run.attemptTotal}` : ''
}

function IncubatorSlot({ slot, onToggle, onRun }) {
  const enabled = !!slot.schedule?.enabled
  const active = !!slot.running
  const due = fmtCountdown(slot.schedule?.nextRunAt)
  const runner = slot.runner || slot.schedule?.runner || 'script'
  const ringColor = slot.tone === 'core' ? '#22d3ee' : '#a78bfa'

    // Strip ANSI codes and extract only content lines (skip headers/metadata/separators)
    const clean = raw.replace(/\x1b\[[0-9;]*[mGKH]/g, '')

    let afterMatch = false
    for (const line of clean.split('\n')) {

      if (/^={5,}/.test(t) || /^─{5,}/.test(t)) { afterMatch = false; continue }
      if (!t || /^Results for:/.test(t)) continue
      if (/^\[\d+\]\s+\w/.test(t) || /^Source:/.test(t)) { afterMatch = false; continue }
      if (/^Match:/.test(t)) { afterMatch = true; continue }
      if (afterMatch) out.push(line)
    }
    return out.join('\n').trim().slice(0, maxChars)
  } catch {
    return ''
  }
}

app.get('/api/ai/status', async (req, res) => {
  try {
    const r = await fetch(`${HAILO_URL}/api/tags`)
    const data = await r.json()
    const loaded = data.models?.some(m => m.name?.includes('qwen2.5-instruct'))
    res.json({ available: true, modelLoaded: loaded, models: data.models })
  } catch {
    res.json({ available: false, modelLoaded: false })
  }
})

app.post('/api/ai/analyze', async (req, res) => {
  try {
    // Use MemPalace semantic search for compact context instead of raw file dumps
    const palaceCtx = queryMemPalace('pi-pulse seed direction current state active threads', { wing: 'lab', results: 3, maxChars: 600 })
    let recentLog = ''
    try { recentLog = fs.readFileSync('/home/admin/lab/RUN_LOG.md', 'utf8').slice(-400) } catch {}

    const prompt = `You are an AI critic analyzing an evolving creative/design project.

CONTEXT (from memory palace):
${palaceCtx || '(unavailable)'}

RECENT RUN LOG (tail):
${recentLog}

Respond in this exact format (5 lines, no extra text):
DIRECTION: <one sentence on where the project is heading>
STRONGEST: <what is working best right now>
WEAKEST: <what is hurting coherence most>
DRIFT: <yes/no — is it drifting from the seed? why>
NEXT: <the single most useful next mutation>`

    const r = await fetch(`${HAILO_URL}/api/generate`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ model: AI_MODEL, prompt, stream: false }),
      signal: AbortSignal.timeout(60000),
    })

    if (!r.ok) {
      const text = await r.text()
      return res.status(502).json({ ok: false, error: text })
    }

    const data = await r.json()

    // Write parsed feedback to DRIFT_FEEDBACK.md so the lab agent reads it next run
    try {
      const ts = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 16).replace('T', ' ')
      fs.writeFileSync('/home/admin/lab/DRIFT_FEEDBACK.md',
        `# Drift Feedback — ${ts}\n\n${data.response.trim()}\n`)
      fs.writeFileSync('/home/admin/lab/DRIFT_FEEDBACK.json',
        JSON.stringify({ ok: true, response: data.response, model: AI_MODEL, ts: Date.now() }))
    } catch { /* non-fatal */ }

    res.json({ ok: true, response: data.response, model: AI_MODEL })
  } catch (err) {
    res.status(500).json({ ok: false, error: err.message })
  }
})

app.get('/api/ai/latest', (req, res) => {

    res.json(data)
  } catch {
    res.json({ ok: false })
  }
})
